title: Firebot Community Plugin Author Manifest
description: A manifest file that describes the author of one or more Firebot community plugins.

name.description: Your name. This will usually be the same as your Twitch username and author directory name. However, it may contain different capitalization (e.g. `DennisOnTheInternet`).

userId.description: Your Twitch account's internal user ID (e.g. `50989853`). You can find this in your Firebot `auth-twitch.json` file.
